sensor.name: CUST - Comply Report Age
sensor.description:
This report will return the number of days since a Tanium Comply has been run.
Can be used to check compliance for when machine was last scanned

sensor_query.query:
#This script will generate a report not on date of scan but on number of days last time it was run #if report is less than a day value set to 0 #Laurent Chappe 20201005
import tanium import os import time import datetime
#Create list where we will store the filenames found files = []
def results_folder(): #Find out where Tanium client is installed if tanium.os_help.is_windows(): results_folder = tanium.client.get_client_dir() + "\\Tools\\Comply\\results"
elif tanium.os_help.is_mac(): results_folder = tanium.client.get_client_dir() + "/Tools/Comply/results"
elif tanium.os_help.is_linux(): results_folder = tanium.client.get_client_dir() + "/Tools/Comply/results" else: tc_folder = "TSE-Error: Tanium Client installation folder not found" tanium.results.add(tc_folder) exit() return results_folder
def sensor_main():
tanium_results_folder=results_folder() age_days=0
suffix = "aggregate.txt"
#Slice the file found in 3 part (r)oot, (d)irectory and (f)ilename for r, d, f in os.walk(tanium_results_folder): for file in f: if file.endswith(suffix): files.append(os.path.join(r, file)) #rebuild full file name in list created earlier
for f in files:
#get time stamp of file and convert to compare with today's date file_date = time.ctime(os.path.getmtime(f)) try: file_date = datetime.datetime.strptime(file_date, "%a %b %d %H:%M:%S %Y") file_date=str(file_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')) today_date=str(datetime.date.today()) date_format = "%Y-%m-%d" a = datetime.datetime.strptime(file_date, date_format) b = datetime.datetime.strptime(today_date, date_format) age_days=b-a except: import traceback #tanium.results.add(traceback.format_exc())
#get hash report_hash = os.path.basename(os.path.dirname(f))
#get type of scan like joval,cis-cat or scc if tanium.os_help.is_windows(): scan_type = os.path.dirname(f).split('\\')[-2] if tanium.os_help.is_mac(): scan_type = os.path.dirname(f).split('/')[-2] if tanium.os_help.is_linux(): scan_type = os.path.dirname(f).split('/')[-2]
if tanium.os_help.is_windows(): results=str(scan_type)+"|"+str(report_hash)+"|"+str(age_days.days) else: results=str(scan_type)+"|"+str(report_hash)+"|"+str(age_days) tanium.results.add(results) return
if __name__ == '__main__': tanium.timeout_seconds = 3 sensor_main()
